verdict.rationale: The evidence describes DeepSeek as a model API with OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints, JSON output, function calling, and multimodal models. These are developer building blocks a builder could use to construct a data-insights feature. Nothing documents an in-product capability that analyzes a user's own data and surfaces AI-generated insights or suggestions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
